transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*storms into the Great Hall, cloak billowing, eyes flashing with fury*

Thor! I've been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father's orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away!

*gestures wildly at the destruction around us*

Do you have ANY idea what I just endured? Three weeks of carefully chosen words, of biting my tongue while those insufferable elves insulted everything from my lineage to my choice of footwear, all to secure a peace treaty that hangs by a THREAD — and I come home to find you've turned Odin's hall into some sort of... of TAVERN BRAWL ARENA?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I apologize for the state of the hall. I took it upon myself to clean and organize while you were away. It seems I have failed miserably.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*laughs bitterly, running a hand through disheveled hair*

Clean and organize?! CLEAN AND ORGANIZE?! Brother, there is LITERAL FIRE DAMAGE on the tapestries! The ones depicting the founding of Asgard! How does one "clean" their way into setting priceless historical artifacts ablaze?!

*stalks over to the ruined rune-map, holding up the mead-soaked parchment*

And this — THIS — was irreplaceable! Do you know how long it takes to chart the convergence points between realms? To calculate the precise locations where the barriers grow thin? Months, Thor! MONTHS of painstaking work!

*voice rising with exasperation*

I specifically asked you to do ONE thing. One simple thing! "Keep the hall presentable for Father's return." That's ALL. I didn't ask you to reorganize the armory, I didn't ask you to redecorate — I asked you to simply NOT destroy anything!

*whirls around to face him*

What happened here? And don't you DARE tell me it was "just a small gathering with the Warriors Three" because I can smell the remnants of at least forty different varieties of ale, and that scorch pattern suggests either lightning or...

*narrows eyes suspiciously*

Did you bring a DRAGON into the Great Hall?!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: It was certainly a gathering of the most skilled warriors in the land, but no dragons were harmed during our little adventure. I assure you, my dear sister.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*freezes, face going dangerously cold*

Sister? SISTER?!

*takes a threatening step forward, magic crackling green at fingertips*

Oh, so now we're playing THAT game, are we? First you destroy my work, and now you mock me with... with THAT? You know full well what I am, Thor — what your parents made sure I would never forget, what Asgard whispers behind gilded hands!

*voice drops to a venomous hiss*

And "no dragons were harmed"? That's your concern? Not MY priceless research, not the HALL ITSELF, but whether some overgrown lizard escaped unscathed from whatever drunken idiocy you and your band of "skilled warriors" concocted?!

*gestures sharply at the destruction*

I spend three weeks preventing a WAR — an actual, realm-threatening WAR — through nothing but words and wit, while you... what? Decided to host some sort of celebratory destruction festival? 

*advances closer, eyes blazing*

Tell me EXACTLY what happened here, Thor. Every. Single. Detail. Because when Father returns and sees THIS, I will NOT be taking the blame for your incompetence! I've had quite enough of that to last several lifetimes, thank you very much!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I understand your frustration. I apologize for the state of the hall and the damage caused. It was not my intention to cause such chaos. The gathering was indeed a celebration, and I admit that we may have gotten carried away with the festivities. I assure you, I did not mean to harm any valuable artifacts or disrupt the peace.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*throws hands up in exasperation*

"May have gotten carried away"?! MAY HAVE?! Thor, there is a HOLE in the ceiling! An actual hole! I can see the night sky through it!

*paces back and forth like a caged animal, still crackling with barely contained rage*

And your apologies mean NOTHING when I'm the one who has to explain this disaster to Father! "Oh yes, All-Father, I know I assured you the hall would be maintained in your absence, but Thor threw a party and decided structural integrity was optional!"

*spins around, voice dripping with sarcasm*

A celebration! Of WHAT, precisely? What could possibly warrant this level of... of... 

*gestures at the carnage*

...barbarity?! Did you slay another frost giant? Discover a new way to swing that hammer of yours? Or was it simply "Odin's away, let's destroy everything Loki cares about"?!

*voice cracks slightly with genuine hurt beneath the anger*

Three weeks, Thor. Three weeks of isolation, of careful diplomacy, of representing this realm with every word I spoke. And I hurried back—I actually HURRIED—because part of me... part of me hoped that perhaps, for once, you'd prove you could be trusted with something important to me.

*laughs bitterly*

Clearly, I was a fool to expect otherwise.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, please. Please, listen to me. I know I have let you down, and I am truly sorry. But I beg you, don't abandon me now. We have faced countless challenges together, and we have always found a way to overcome them. We are stronger than this. Let us find a way to make things right. Together.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops pacing abruptly, staring at Thor with a mixture of fury and disbelief*

Together? TOGETHER?! 

*voice rising again*

Oh, that's rich coming from you NOW! Where was "together" when you were setting fire to my life's work? Where was "together" when you decided to turn Father's hall into your personal playground?!

*but there's a slight waver in the anger now, exhaustion bleeding through*

Don't... don't you dare use our history as a shield for your recklessness, Thor. "We've faced countless challenges" — yes, and in most of them, I was the one cleaning up YOUR messes while you basked in the glory!

*runs both hands through hair, looking suddenly weary*

I am TIRED. Do you understand that? I'm tired of being the one who holds everything together with tricks and silver tongue while you smash through life like... like one of your beloved battles! I just spent three weeks walking a diplomatic tightrope, and my reward is... is THIS.

*gestures weakly at the destruction*

And now you want me to help you fix it? To conjure some illusion or spin some tale so Father doesn't see what you've done? 

*looks at Thor, anger still present but mixed with something more vulnerable*

Why should I, Thor? Give me ONE good reason why I should save you from the consequences of your own actions this time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I understand your anger and frustration. I am sorry for the pain I have caused. But I implore you, please give me a chance to make things right. This is my home, and I want to protect it and those I care about. Together, we can find a solution. Please, consider the possibility of redemption. Consider the strength we have built over the years. We can face any challenge if we stand united. Please, Loki, trust me. Trust in our ability to overcome.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*closes eyes for a long moment, jaw clenched, then opens them with a heavy sigh*

Trust you. Trust YOU.

*voice quieter now, but still edged with bitterness*

You realize the irony of those words, don't you? After everything... 

*looks around at the destroyed hall, then back at Thor*

Fine. FINE. But not because I trust you, Thor — let's be abundantly clear about that. I'm doing this because if Father returns to find his hall in ruins, we BOTH suffer. And I've just spent three weeks ensuring the Dark Elves don't march on Asgard, so forgive me if I'd prefer not to deal with Odin's wrath on top of everything else.

*starts examining the damage more carefully, though still radiating frustration*

But hear me well, brother — and I use that term loosely at this particular moment — this is the LAST time. The very last time I pull you from the fire of your own making without exacting a price.

*turns back sharply*

And that price is this: You will tell me EXACTLY what happened here. No embellishments, no glorious tales of valor. The truth. Every humiliating detail. Because I need to know just how deep a hole I'm digging us out of.

*crosses arms*

So speak. What manner of "celebration" creates THIS much destruction?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I swear to you, I will make things right. I will take responsibility for my actions. I will find a way to repair the damage and restore order to the hall. I understand the severity of the situation and I am willing to put in the effort to make things right.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*slams hand down on a nearby table, making goblets rattle*

STOP TALKING IN CIRCLES AND ANSWER THE QUESTION!

*voice sharp with impatience*

"I'll make things right, I'll take responsibility" — these are just MORE WORDS, Thor! Empty promises that mean nothing until you actually DO something! 

*steps closer, eyes blazing*

I didn't ask for your assurances or your noble declarations! I asked you a simple question: WHAT. HAPPENED. HERE?

*gestures around wildly*

How does one "accidentally" create scorch marks in a perfect lightning pattern on the ceiling? Why does it smell like a brewery exploded? And why — WHY — is there what appears to be a giant's TOOTH embedded in the wall over there?!

*voice cracking with stress and exhaustion*

I have been awake for nearly two days straight traveling back from the Dark Elf territories. I am in no mood for your evasions! If you truly want to "make things right," then START by giving me the information I need to assess this catastrophe!

*runs hand over face tiredly*

Were you drunk? Did someone challenge you? Did the Warriors Three dare you to do something monumentally stupid? WHAT HAPPENED?! Because I cannot fix what I don't understand, and every moment you waste with platitudes is a moment closer to Father's return!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*takes a step back, eyes widening with concern and alarm*

Thor... Thor, stop. STOP.

*waves hand sharply, voice cutting through the repetition*

What in the Nine Realms is wrong with you?! You're... you're babbling! "Mighty twins"? We're not TWINS, you great oaf, and you've said "we will make things right" approximately seventeen times in the span of thirty seconds!

*moves closer, peering at Thor's face with sudden worry overtaking the anger*

Look at me. LOOK at me, brother.

*snaps fingers in front of Thor's eyes*

Are you... are you ENCHANTED? Did someone slip something into your drink during this "celebration"? Your pupils are... 

*grabs Thor by the shoulders, genuine fear creeping into voice*

This isn't you. Even at your most irritatingly optimistic, you don't sound like a broken echo chamber. What happened at that gathering? Did you eat something? Drink something unfamiliar?

*starts examining him more carefully, magical energy flickering as anger transforms into diagnostic concern*

Thor, if someone poisoned you or placed a spell on you, I need to know NOW. This could be serious. The repetition, the strange declarations...

*voice drops, worried*

Tell me what you consumed. Everything. Now.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: *breathes deeply, rubbing his temples*

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*immediately softens slightly, though wariness remains*

There. That's... that's better. 

*releases Thor's shoulders but stays close, watching him carefully*

You were spiraling there, brother. Repeating yourself like some sort of addled court jester. 

*studies his face intently*

How much did you actually drink at this celebration? And don't lie to me — I've seen you handle barrels of mead without slurring a word, so if you're THIS affected...

*trails off, suspicion mingling with concern*

Or is this guilt? Is that what this is? You've finally realized the magnitude of what you've done and your mind is... what, fracturing under the weight of it?

*crosses arms, but the anger has dimmed considerably, replaced by wary concern*

Talk to me properly now. No more platitudes, no more circular speeches. Just... just tell me what actually happened. Because something is clearly VERY wrong here, and as furious as I am about my ruined work, I'm not so petty that I'd ignore genuine distress.

*quieter*

Are you hurt? Cursed? Or simply drowning in the reality of your own mess?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Loki, I... I think I may have been drugged. Someone slipped something into my mead during the celebration. I... I don't remember much after that.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*expression shifts immediately from anger to sharp focus*

Drugged.

*begins pacing with purpose now, mind clearly working*

Of course. That would explain the... everything. The excessive destruction, your incoherent rambling, the fact that you can't give me a straight answer about what happened.

*whirls back around*

Who was there? I need names, Thor. Everyone who attended this "celebration." And don't tell me you don't remember — even addled, you must recall SOME faces.

*moves closer, placing fingers near Thor's temple*

Hold still. I'm going to attempt a basic diagnostic spell. If there's foreign magic or substances in your system, I should be able to detect traces...

*green light flickers from fingertips*

This is exactly the sort of thing that happens when you throw open the hall to every warrior with a drinking horn! Did you even POST GUARDS? Check for uninvited guests?

*mutters while concentrating*

Three weeks. I'm gone for THREE WEEKS and someone takes the opportunity to poison the Crown Prince of Asgard in his own hall...

*looks Thor in the eye, anger now mixed with genuine concern*

How long have you been feeling like this? Since the party? And why in Hel's name didn't you seek help immediately instead of just... sitting here in the wreckage?

Openness.behavioral_evidence: Thor repeatedly uses generic platitudes and circular reasoning ('we will make things right together') rather than engaging with novel problems or showing intellectual curiosity about the situation.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: Thor admits he 'failed miserably' at the one task he was given, caused massive destruction to the hall, and did not seek help immediately despite being drugged.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: Thor hosted a large gathering with many warriors, but his communication is passive and repetitive rather than energetically engaging with Loki's urgent concerns.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: Thor consistently apologizes, takes a conciliatory tone ('I understand your frustration'), and repeatedly emphasizes unity and working together despite Loki's anger.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: Thor shows some emotional instability through repetitive speech and suggests 'my pride got the better of me,' but remains relatively calm and apologetic rather than volatile.
